sections.overview:
This skill teaches advertising managers how to develop effective marketing campaigns through a structured approach. It covers onboarding new campaigns by establishing clear advertising goals, distinguishing between leading and lagging indicators, and aligning budgets with objectives. The skill breaks down how to structure advertising strategies by identifying marketing channels and understanding the stages of marketing funnels for both B2C and B2B companies—from awareness through purchase. Marketing managers and small business owners benefit by learning to diagnose which funnel stages need improvement and create actionable, realistic marketing plans rather than pursuing overnight success.
Onboarding a new marketing campaign and setting actionable goals
Breaking down high-level objectives into leading indicators
Structuring marketing budgets to align with campaign objectives
Analyzing marketing funnels to identify optimization opportunities
